influences.name: Pharrell Williams
influences.context: A friend of mine by the name of Pharrel Williams, was like 'Yo! Lil bro, how's the shoe thing going?' and I'm like, 'We're figuring it out, we just got a few samples, they're horrible. This is going to be a long-winded process.' He's like 'Hold on, I'm going to put you in contact with someone named Paul that works at Converse.'
